speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a penny. It is a full thumb short of the notch. I am not cutting another. Board is threepence when you sit to it, and I am not making a week's sum of one dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence, then, and three bites. The desk stays upstairs. I am not bringing Raleigh down with it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I'll keep the rest under the cloth. You have paper under your arm that has nothing on it. I am not inking it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it blank. I am back at two. The scarf comes off for the oath and goes on again after.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat, and go when you must. A penny is the loaf. The threepence is the sitting. I have said both, and I will not say them at supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both heard. The coffer stays shut. Fivepence this morning did not come out of it.
